title: Networks of stress, affect and eating behaviour: anticipated stress coping — predicts goal-congruent eating in young adults
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Sample limited to young, predominantly female, academic participants; - Limited generalizability; - Self-reported EMA data may be subject to bias; - Did not differentiate specific coping styles or food environments.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. The authors mention that the data are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request, but do not specify a public repository. Code availability is declared but not linked to a specific repository.
